info.name: Retrieve a list of artifact ingestion states

params.name: lastCompletedBefore
params.description: Filter to only results that have been last marked as completed before this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: lastCompletedAfter
params.description: Filter to only results that have been last marked as completed after this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: firstCompletedBefore
params.description: Filter to only results that have been first marked as completed before this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: firstCompletedAfter
params.description: Filter to only results that have been first marked as completed after this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: first
params.description: The number of results to return. Default value is 10. Any custom value specified must lie between 0 and 100, inclusive.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor to start returning results from

items.docs: Returns a list of artifact ingestion states.

info.name: Retrieve the artifact ingestion state for an artifact

params.name: qid
params.description: QID of the entity to retrieve

items.docs: Retrieve the artifact ingestion state for an artifact

Creates a new artifact. This endpoint can be used to create artifacts in either simple formats such as CSV and JSON where the artifact is included in the HTTP request body, or as files where the data is sent in the multipart/form-data format as an uploaded file. If the artifact is detected as a duplicate, via md5 hash, the existing artifact will be returned instead of creating a new one.
Returns the artifact with the specified tag

params.name: qid
params.description: QID of the entity to retrieve

items.docs: Returns the artifact with the specified QID. Supports optional expansion for the "summary" field, the "derivatives" field, and the "tags" field. For example: `/artifacts/<qid>?expand=summary&expand=derivatives&expand=tags`

params.name: optimized
params.description: Controls whether to return an optimized version of the artifact. If set to true, optimization is enabled, and an optimized version of the artifact is available, returns the optimized version; otherwise, returns the original.

params.name: qid
params.description: QID of the entity to retrieve

items.docs: Downloads the artifact with the specified QID as binary.
